description: Return the catalog record of one indexed shop, from its origin (https://shop.example) or from any page URL on it, such as a product link. The record is the same JSON as GET /catalog/shop?origin=<origin>: name, provenance, DID and Agent Card URL when signed or claimed, and when the catalog last read it. Stored data only: nothing is fetched. A host the catalog has not indexed is refused by name.

url.description: The shop's origin or a page URL on it (http or https).

name: catalog.lookup
title: Look up one shop
